test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of April 2022, to avail the scheme of Permanent Residency Status to Foreign Investors, how much investment a foreign investor will have to make within 18 months?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹10 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of April 2022, to avail the scheme of Permanent Residency Status to Foreign Investors, the investment amount required was INR 10 Crore within 18 months.
 
• **Here's a breakdown of the scheme and its requirements:**
 
 
• **Permanent Residency Status (PRS) for Foreign Investors:** This scheme aimed to attract foreign investment and boost economic growth in India. It offered a pathway to permanent residency for eligible foreign investors who met specific criteria. 
 
• **Investment Threshold:** The key requirement was a substantial investment in India. In April 2022, the threshold for obtaining PRS was set at INR 10 Crore within 18 months.
 
• This investment had to be made under the Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) route. 
 
• **Employment Generation: **The scheme also stipulated that the investment should result in employment for at least 20 resident Indians in every financial year. 
 
• **Eligibility: **The scheme was applicable to foreign nationals, excluding citizens of Pakistan or third-country nationals of Pakistani origin. 
 
• **Benefits of PRS: **Obtaining PRS granted several advantages to foreign investors, including:
 
• **Long-term Stay: **PRS holders were allowed to stay in India for an extended period without restrictions on each visit.
 
• **Multiple Entry:** PRS provided for multiple entries into India. 
 
• **No Registration Requirements:** PRS holders were exempted from registration requirements with the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) or Foreigners Registration Office (FRO).
 
• **Property Ownership:** PRS holders were permitted to purchase one residential property for dwelling purposes. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Rs. 25 crore in 36 months to secure a Permanent Residency Status. The foreign investment should result in generating employment to at least 20 resident Indians. The PRS will serve as a multiple entry visa without any stay stipulation.
